root_admission.decision_basis: Actual fine and E13 native calculations are complete and fully published/readback verified. E13 raw mean/P10 improve but tiny fractional-contact peak drives joint8 mean to3.37544e-6V/m; no adoption. Complete missing numerical high-volume diagnostics and40unloaded potential probes per actual available dataset from stored native arrays only. Preserve all originals and all failed mesh/contact holds. Fixed cutoffs come from original coarse101B0 and are numerical comparisons, never activation thresholds. Same-layer extrapolation<=one native spacing is separately labelled/unverified and strict availability/missing rows remain explicit. One low-RSS finite batch before source-only lower-memory Q operator validation; no new Q/PDE/E/angular work.

ellipse_review.decision_basis: Reviewed actual26PASS/2newRHS/1angular/2immutablealiases, raw target0.0908973/0.0838661V/m, minimumpositivecontactfraction4.162175e-7, lumpedcontactJmax1993.164A/m2 versus skinvectorJmax0.1193676A/m2, joint8target3.375443e-6/3.114343e-6V/m. Extreme contact predictions are unresolved model/discretization diagnostics, not validated skin burdens. Do not change area or prune cells; retain fineB0/P23 adjacent14/18 and16/18 failures and physiological/experimental limits.

directional_search.metric: max_sampled_real_unit_u 2 min(abs(E2000 dot u),abs(E2010 dot u))
directional_search.angular_maximum_scope: Sampled lower bound; not continuum angular maximum

coordinate_system.weighting: Caller-passed original fractional native ROI weights in m3; stable inverse volume ECDF

conventions.current: Derived gamma*E total current including displacement; not independent validation
conventions.modulation: Two actual distinct sinusoidal carriers only; no multi-frequency extrapolation

thresholds.high_modulation_volume: not_run; no preregistered numerical cutoffs in this provisional batch

provisional_field.lateral_source: SelectivityShapeBasis.java ShapeNet.field/edgeCurrent; same archive ExploreBasis.edgeCurrent sign
provisional_field.lateral_definition: Each existing +x/+y edge (a,b) contributes (phi_a-phi_b)/(2*h) to BOTH incident cells in its oriented component
provisional_field.missing_neighbor_rule: No edge means zero face contribution; wall cells retain half contribution, never a full one-sided derivative
provisional_field.conditional_scope: Continuous z conditional on the registered discrete XY graph and inherited material/contact/circuit assumptions

normalizations.current_definition: Sum of individual independent-output RMS magnitudes as bookkeeping, not a unique total-current physical invariant
normalizations.burden_caps_scope: Baseline numerical values only; not human safety limits
